name: Focused Architect
description: Plans ahead and keeps things organized, but prefers working things out quietly over talking them through.

name: Independent Strategist
description: Prefers working things out solo, even inside a group; contributes best async.

name: Study Captain
description: Shows up prepared, pushes through hard material, and keeps sessions on track.

name: Balanced Collaborator
description: A moderate, well-rounded study profile without an extreme trait signature.

name: Collaborative Guide
description: Learns by explaining and talking problems through out loud; keeps the group engaged.
